controls.title: Storage media
controls.description: Storage media: Manage the full lifecycle of removable and fixed storage media including USB drives, tapes, external hard drives, optical discs, and memory cards. Sourced from NIST SP 800-53 MP-4 (Media Storage), MP-5 (Media Transport), and MP-6 (Media Sanitization). Media must be inventoried, labeled, and stored securely. During transport, storage media must be protected using locked courier cases, tamper-evident seals, or encryption to prevent unauthorized access or data leakage. Media containing sensitive data must be sanitized or destroyed at end of life using approved methods such as degaussing, overwriting, or physical destruction. Removable media controls must prevent unauthorized connection of personal storage devices.

Sourced from NIST SP 800-53 CP-9 (System Backup) and CP-9(1) (Testing Recovery).
